text:
carla: quick heads-up — did a bring-up of rerank-small-v3 quantized (post-training quant) against our eval harness. overall NDCG about same but MRR down ~11% on short queries (<=5 tokens). unsure if padding/priming or embed norm shift. :confused:
ben: numbers pls? short queries only or global?
carla: full eval: global MRR 0.356 -> 0.349 (-2%), short MRR 0.421 -> 0.375 (-10.9%). NDCG@10 almost identical.
dmitri: interesting. does inference pipeline add any prefix prompts for reranker? that could change tokenization/padding distribution.
carla: our harness uses a single-line canonical prompt; prod has a tiny priming header for context. I reran harness both ways, the primed eval reduces the gap but doesn't eliminate it.
alice: could be embedding scale change after quantization — MRR sensitive to top-k tie-breaks. can you dump embedding L2 norms before/after quant for same candidates?
carla: good idea. attached quick sample stats: pre-quant mean L2 3.12, std 0.23; post-quant mean 2.89, std 0.48. also more outliers low-norm after quant.
eva: that smells like quantization biasing smaller magnitudes. also check layernorm/scale ops inside model — sometimes PTQ recipes fold scales differently.
dmitri: also verify tokenizer parity. small queries are sensitive: whitespace vs trimmed newline changes token counts and thus padding. run `python -c "from tokenizers import ..."` to compare token ids on the failing queries.
carla: ran token parity check on a 200-sample: 12 mismatches where prod inserted an extra ``[UNK]``-ish sequence because of leading whitespace in the priming header. when I stripped primer, tokenization matched.
aben: (typo)
ben: ok so both tokenization and norm shift could be compounding. priorities: (1) reproduce delta on a per-query basis, (2) isolate quant vs tokenizer effect, (3) try simple rescaling of embeddings before scoring as temporary mitigation.
dmitri: for (1) I can run per-query delta overnight: baseline FP16 vs PTQ on the same candidates, dump ranking lists + score diffs. cmd I will run: ```bash
python eval_per_query.py --model rerank-small-v3 --splits short --out per_query_diffs.json
```
carla: perfect. for (2) I'll run a harness where we force tokenizer to harness settings (trim primer, normalize whitespace) and then feed quant model.
alice: quick experiment to try: after quant, apply L2 rescale factor computed from mean norms ratio (pre/post) per-batch before computing dot scores. if that recovers MRR a bit it's a useful mitigation while we refine PTQ.
eva: also open a tiny ticket with PTQ recipe details (calibration set size, per-channel vs per-tensor). I think we used smaller calibrations for this round.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary for rerank-small-v3-ptq scheduled at 2026-03-22T02:00Z (ETA) — ping @dmitri if rollout should be paused.
dmitri: pause until we have per-query diffs and tokenization parity confirmed.
carla: plan set: dmitri owns per-query diffs, carla owns tokenizer parity check + embed dumps, alice will prototype rescale mitigation, eva files PTQ recipe ticket. We'll regroup in tomorrow standup with numbers. :thumbsup:
ben: thanks — sounds good. :eyes:
